## Lanyard 0.4.1 beta
The first public build of Lanyard. Everything since the internal 0.4.0 builds, in one place.
### New - **Automatic updates.** Lanyard now checks for new builds and installs them when you say so. Settings → General has Check for Updates and a switch for automatic checks. Updates are signed and verified before anything is installed. - **Support from inside the app.** Settings → Support files a bug report, feature request or question. You see the exact text first; home folder paths, project folder names, emails and keys are already removed. - **Installer.** A drag-to-Applications disk image with a guided first-run setup.
### Faster - Searching 2,000 chats takes under 2 ms per keystroke (was 30 ms). - Renaming a chat no longer blocks the window; names are saved in the background. - The IDE extension's state is built off the main thread. - Live sessions no longer rewrite the whole session cache on every transcript line.
### Safer - Hardened runtime on the app and every component. - The update feed, the support report redaction and the IDE command gate were reviewed in a security audit; all findings are fixed. - Nothing is sent anywhere except the update check and the support reports you review and send.
### Known limits in this beta - This build is signed with a local certificate, not a Developer ID. The first time you open it, macOS blocks it: go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway. The next release is notarized and opens normally. - Beta builds update to later betas and to the next stable release automatically.
